verdict.rationale: MoonPay's docs show KYC/onboarding is embedded within its widget/SDK flows (auth frame, challenge frame, MFA login, 'connect existing MoonPay users') and it stores KYC/payment details for reuse, which does clear counterparties before money moves, but this is bundled into the consumer purchase UX rather than exposed as a standalone, ops-controllable KYC/KYB API for arbitrary counterparties (e.g., no documented business/KYB verification endpoint, no explicit 'approve counterparty' status API separate from the purchase pipeline). missing for 10: dedicated KYB/business verification endpoints, explicit counterparty-clearance status API independent of a transaction, and independent/third-party confirmation that programmatic onboarding works end-to-end without the hosted widget.
